title: Resolution urging Albany to ban risky food additives
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.1239A/A.1556A, which would ban potassium bromate, propylparaben and FD&C Red No. 3 in food. The state bill would also bar schools from selling food containing certain artificial color additives during school hours and tighten reporting requirements for substances labeled 'Generally Recognized as Safe'.
